svg.text: M18 — real-workload results: page-aware Bulk engine vs Vortex-calibrated SIMT
SpMV over four SuiteSparse matrices, BFS over two SNAP graphs. Trace-driven, reads only, identical hierarchy in every arm.
same-trace = identical instruction stream (index charged twice to the hybrid)
Where the hybrid's gain comes from
fraction of baseline cycles: index-stream cost vs the engine's own added cost
benefit = index offload − engine cost; both are measured, not modelled
BFS: the ceiling for a single-level engine
the dist-probe stream removed; no implementation can do this
dist probe — the only stream a one-level engine could address
BFS is not evaluable by this engine: chained gather + writes (M18 BFS report §1)
